reviews.text: "[Service, Technician] Kris was super friendly and knowledgeable. Diagnosed and fixed the issues quickly and efficiently. Answered my questions and explained and showed evidence of the issues and exactly how he corrected it. Had no issues rechecking when I experienced a problem after the initial visit.
reviews.author: Jared Shugart

reviews.text:
My regular pool maintenance person accidentally broke a valve in my pool pump that causes the water to leak and as a result the inline chlorinator was not usable. Contacted my home warranty service and they sent Kris White from Expert Pool service.

His service was phenomenal from the get go. He clearly stated what can be fixed and for what items I’d need to be paying extra as it may not be covered in my warranty.

He also used best use of the available resources to not only make sure the leak is fixed but also to a point where the chlorinator can be used to the bare minimum (fixing chlorinator is not covered in home warranty)

He also provided suggestions on what needs to be done with the pool during winter.
reviews.author: Merin C

reviews.text: Expert Pools has been my trusted pool service for over seven years.  I originally became a customer through a home warranty program.  While the warranty service declined sharply after 2021, Expert Pools has remained consistently excellent.  Whenever I have an issue, they’re my first phone call.  They’re knowledgeable, fairly priced, and their work is exceptional.  If you need reliable service to keep your pool and equipment running at their best, I couldn’t recommend anyone more than Shane, Cheryl, Jamie, and the rest of the team at Expert Pools!
reviews.author: Roy Hardgrove

reviews.text: Kris provided excellent service. He arrived on time, kept me well-informed throughout the process, and ensured I was updated every step of the way. Before leaving, he thoroughly cleaned up the work area, which I greatly appreciated. Kudos to Kris for his professionalism and attention to detail.
reviews.author: Roger Crago

reviews.text: Joseph always does a great job when servicing my pool! The work is quick and done right. Joseph is always very friendly and explains everything that is found during the filter cleanings. I will always use ExpertPools to keep my pool running and looking great!
reviews.author: Karin Hiltz

reviews.text: This was my 2nd experience with Expertpools, both were arranged by our home warranty company and both were outstanding experiences. They are extremely thorough, honest, and transparent. In this appointment, Shane took extra time to field various questions I had about the pool and maintenance. Despite being his last appointment of the day, he went above and beyond. I highly recommend Expert Pools and would use them exclusively outside of my home warranty.
reviews.author: tony bridge

reviews.text: Jamie at Expert Pools is hands down the best.  His customer service and courteousness is second to none.  I can't recommend him enough.
reviews.author: Adrian Herschberg

reviews.text: Great service from Expertpools!  Jamie was great.  Very friendly and professional, very diligent. Gave assurance he would gladly return if the leak wasn't totally repaired.
reviews.author: James Sullivan
